payload.rationale: The document is a Phase 2 E2E test reproducing the missing-id failure pattern — a ## heading with no id field — and requires the pipeline to not crash and produce a valid slug. This directly extends the existing Narrative_ContentDerivedSlugGeneration (frame: reliable slug generation when explicit identifiers are omitted) and the unplaced Position_MissingIdPipelineSlugGeneration (frame: how the pipeline generates slugs when no explicit id is provided). Both expressions under those nodes — 'Submitted without an explicit id field' and 'The pipeline must produce a slug from the memory content — either via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback — and commit the file successfully' — are load-bearing because the passes need to bind this new sample to the prior assertions and potentially extend the narrative. Actor_XenaExpertgh is expanded to confirm attribution. I did not expand ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst (Xena's consulting methodology) or ns__Actor_XenaGithubber as they bear no relation to slug generation or pipeline ingestion.
